faqs.a: selectNsolve is a Google Sheets add-on for solving equations right in your spreadsheet. Basic is free and available now: single-variable solving with your own search bounds, standard operators, and Unicode variable names and units.
Basic is free forever, no credit card. Pro will be $7.99 a month or $59 a year. Classroom will be $179 a year. Pro and Classroom are coming soon. Details are on the Pricing page.

Pro adds an AI-managed multi-variable solver: systems of up to 30 variables, with the AI tracking each variable's min, max and precision, plus early access to new features. It's coming soon at $7.99 a month or $59 a year.

Classroom is for instructors and institutions: everything in Pro, up to 35 student seats, shared equation libraries, an instructor dashboard and an onboarding call, at $179 a year. School and non-profit discounts are available. It's coming soon.
selectNsolve runs in Google Sheets. Install selectNsolve Basic from the Google Workspace Marketplace, then open it from the Extensions menu in your sheet.

The Developer API is a live MCP server at myengineeringproject.com/api/mcp. AI agents can create and fill Google Sheets with selectNsolve math. No API key is needed. The API doesn't solve; the add-on does. See the Developer API page.
Email support@myengineeringproject.com, or use the Send us a message form on the Support page.
Pro and Classroom are coming soon. To hear when they launch, email support@myengineeringproject.com or follow @myengproject.
Practical Engineering covers real-world problem solving, and the Study Guides help you prepare for exams. Both are in the menu at the top of the site.
Brazen Sudoku is our puzzle game, at brazensudoku.com.
My Engineering Project LLC is based in St. Petersburg, Florida.
